designationHistory.indexText: Established Jan. 23, 2004, when an act of Congress made the Bogue Phalia Unit of Yazoo NWR the separate Holt Collier National Wildlife Refuge.

review.note: Year confirmed; created by sec. 145 of P.L. 108-199 (the Theodore Roosevelt NWR Act), signed by George W. Bush. Named for Holt Collier, guide on T.R.'s 1902 Mississippi bear hunt.
